cohort: The study included 150 pregnant women with singleton, uncomplicated pregnancy and Gestational Diabetes Mellitus from a tertiary centre in Western Maharashtra.
finding: The study found an increased interventricular septum among the fetuses of mothers with gestational diabetes, but no significant cardiac dysfunction was observed.
cross-section timing: Fetal echocardiography was performed between 24 and 28 weeks of gestation.
gest_age: Fetal echocardiography was performed between 24-28 weeks of gestation, with a mean period of gestation of 25.57 weeks.
